# SCP-082 Containment
By default, SCP-082 spawns in its containment chamber, which restricts its movement and prevents it from leaving. The chamber acts as a safeguard, allowing the object to be contained safely.
[textlink="General information about Fernand" link="Scp082About"]
[textlink="More about methods of escape when playing as Fernand" link="Scp082ContainmentBreach"]
## What Should You Do?
The primary way for the object to breach containment is through the anger mechanic.
[textlink="More about the anger mechanic and other abilities" link="Scp082Abilities"]
Keep in mind that SCP-082 only begins to grow hungry 20 minutes after the round starts. Until then, the "Safe Time" mechanic limits SCP activity and gives personnel time to make their initial preparations for the round.
The personnel's task is to keep Fernand from becoming angry. To do so, they must occasionally bring him one member of D-Class personnel for SCP-082 to eat.
## How Can You Tell How Hungry Fernand Is?
Personnel must notice and prevent SCP-082's anger in time, so correctly judging his hunger is crucial.
Watch SCP-082's behavior, listen to his requests, and simply ask whether he is hungry.
That is all! This is enough to stay informed about Fernand's current condition.
## Fulfilling Requests
During the round, the object may make various requests.
Fulfill them if they are fairly ordinary requests. Examples include: - A D-Class staff member (he may ask for clowns or musicians; they are still D-Class, so simply dress them in the appropriate clothes) - Musical instruments - Kitchen supplies - And so on...
For unusual requests, consult the Senior Researcher or Complex Director, or try to trick him. Fernand is trusting, but his naivety is highly unpredictable. Be careful!
## What Should You Do if the Object Escapes?
Form a group of two or three Security officers; that will be enough.
If Fernand is willing to negotiate, try to resolve the problem through conversation.
You can also exploit his trusting nature and trick him into returning to the containment chamber.
If he is aggressive, two Security officers must grab him simultaneously and administer an amnestic.
While grabbed, Fernand cannot attack or move, leaving him temporarily defenseless.
